UserPromptSubmit.bash: m="${COPILOT_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.debug-dashboard/recording"; [ -f "$m" ] || exit 0; s="$PLUGIN_ROOT/skills/debug-dashboard/scripts/hook.py"; if command -v py >/dev/null 2>&1; then py -3 "$s" UserPromptSubmit; else python3 "$s" UserPromptSubmit; fi 2>/dev/null || true
UserPromptSubmit.powershell: $d = $env:COPILOT_PROJECT_DIR; if (-not $d) { $d = '.' }; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $d '.debug-dashboard/recording') -PathType Leaf)) { exit 0 }; $s = Join-Path $env:PLUGIN_ROOT 'skills/debug-dashboard/scripts/hook.py'; try { if (Get-Command py -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { & py -3 $s UserPromptSubmit 2>$null } elseif (Get-Command python -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { & python $s UserPromptSubmit 2>$null } else { & python3 $s UserPromptSubmit 2>$null } } catch { }; exit 0
